title: Incident Bridge rotating deck prototype: lightweight on-call dashboard & quick-bridge controls
creator: Ava Chen
description: Create a compact, detachable 'Incident Bridge' rotating deck — a lightweight UI surface designed to sit in the Console (and on mobile) that cycles through active incidents relevant to the current on-call assignment. Each card in the deck summarizes incident title, severity, short SLO delta, estimated cost burn rate (tokens/minute or compute units), one-click bridge join, last-run playbook link, and a pinned postmortem link if available. Primary goals: minimize cognitive load for paging engineers, speed up handoff between shifts, and provide actionable context (SLO, cost, runbook, bridge) without navigating away from the Console.
acceptance_criteria: Prototype screens for desktop and compact mobile overlay exist in Figma and annotated for dev
Each deck card shows: incident title, severity color stripe, SLO delta badge (+/-%), cost burn estimate, bridge join CTA, last-run playbook link, and postmortem link if present
Keyboard and screen-reader accessible controls for rotating and focusing a card
On-click bridge join triggers the same flow as the main incident view (preserves role/permissions) in the integration spec
Telemetry events defined for card impressions, bridge join click, postmortem link click, and rotate events
Design handoff includes responsive rules, spacing tokens, micro-interaction specs, and 2 example states (active, acknowledged, resolved)
design_notes: Deck concept: horizontal rotating carousel with modest elevation to avoid covering underlying Console content — user can pin (freeze) the deck to stop rotation
Card density: emphasize one primary action (bridge join) + two contextual links (playbook, postmortem); avoid deeper navigation
SLO delta microcopy: show 3-char badge (+2.1%) with hover tooltip explaining window and baseline
Cost burn: show 'approx compute/min' and a subtle red/yellow/green stripe for trending — not an invoice-level figure
Handoff affordance: ‘Transfer note’ quick input available when pinning a card; stores as pinned comment to incident thread
Mobile overlay: full-bleed bottom sheet variant with same card content but stacked for thumb reach
Animation: 160ms card slide + 80ms fade for details to feel immediate but not jarring
Accessibility: ensure color contrast for severity stripes, aria-live announcements on rotation when focused, and focus trap when opening postmortem link modal
decisions: Use rotating deck rather than large persistent banner to preserve vertical Console real estate
Expose bridge join as primary CTA; other actions demoted to icon buttons to reduce mistaken clicks
Surface estimated cost burn only as relative trend and approximate unit to avoid billing confusion
Store pinned state per user/session — pin persists for 24 hours or until unpinned
Telemetry includes aggregated events (impressions, joins) and sample-level events for privacy-compliant debugging
risks: Deck could distract users if too many cards rotate quickly — mitigated by pin and rotation pause controls
Exposing cost burn may cause alarm if numbers are misinterpreted — copy must explicitly call out approximation
Bridge join from deck must respect RBAC and SSO flows (work with Eng/Security to validate)
Extra surface increases Console render complexity — performance budget review required before implementation
next_steps: Incorporate Eng feasibility feedback from runtime team (ENG-3229) — target review by 2026-03-12
Design usability test with 8 on-call engineers (internal) week of 2026-03-16
Create a lightweight prototype for telemetry and rotation logic in Storybook (task handed to Eng UX)
Publish annotated spec to Confluence and link PR for handoff
Finalize micro-interactions and create dev token mapping for spacing/colors
